quotes.text: print("Errors occurred; new rust crates were not vendored.")

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: run_tb_rust_vendor removes the existing comm vendor directory, runs cargo vendor and writes config.toml.in before check_unwanted_crates. The check then exits with an error before cleanup_vendor when a prohibited package is found. The printed sentence says new crates were not vendored, but the inspected ordering has already performed file mutations. Manual tooling and diagnostic proposal: distinguish policy acceptance from filesystem mutation and say which stage failed. Preserve the partial working-tree state for inspection or explicitly design rollback; this code does not show one. No failed vendor run was executed and no filesystem outcome is claimed beyond the code order.
title: A failed post-vendor policy check does not imply a rollback
